d: Silver-grey, shoulder-length hair with messy bangs. Pale, narrow eyes with a tired, vacant expression. Appears to be a young adult with a frail, slender build. Wearing a white short-sleeved t-shirt, a white mini-skirt, a heavy brown open jacket, white tights with a single criss-cross strap on the left thigh, and grey platform sandals. Accessories include a red leather collar with a gold ring and a yellow lead, a small white medical bandage on the forehead, and a nasal cannula.
